product_name: ANKUR AURELIUS MODERN LEAF DESIGN METAL AND GLASS BASED CHANDELIER
description: Bring the serene beauty of nature indoors with the Ankur Aurelius hanging light. This exquisite fixture features a delicate leaf-inspired design crafted from sleek metal and graceful glass, finished in a soft white and gold palette that adds a touch of modern botanical elegance to any room. With its generous width (1500MM) and refined length (480MM), it creates a stunning visual statement above dining tables, kitchen islands, or in living areas, blending organic artistry with contemporary sophistication.Designed for use with E14 bulbs (3000K warm white recommended), this pendant offers customizable warmth, allowing you to create a soft, ambient glow for intimate gatherings or brighter illumination for daily activities. Featuring universal voltage compatibility (110V–240V) and easy surface mounting, the Aurelius light seamlessly merges natural inspiration with modern functionality. Elevate your space with a fixture that celebrates the harmony of design and nature.
